arabic text: TU ATH’WA MUSHKIL KUSH,\nNOORE JANAB E SAYYEDA
english translation text: YOU ARE THE EIGHT SAVIOUR,\nTHE LIGHT OF BIBI FATIMA (S.A.)

arabic text:
MAULA TU IMAM ZAMIN HAI
TERE QABZE MEI RAAT HAI DIN HAI
TU KHURASAN KA HAI SHEHZADA
HAR SHIFA TERE DAR PE MUMKIN HAI
english translation text:
OH MY IMAM, YOU ARE MY PROTECTOR
THE DAY AND THE NIGHT ARE IN YOUR CONTROL
YOU ARE THE PRINCE OF KHORASAN (MASHHAD)
EVERY CURE CAN BE FOUND AT YOUR DOOR STEP

arabic text:
TERE BABA BABUL HAWAIJ HAIN
USKA SIKKA JAHAA ME RAIJ HAI
HAM TO HAR IMTEHAA SE GUZRENGE
DENE WALA WOHI NATAIJ HAI
english translation text: YOUR FATHER IS BABUL HAWAIJ (THE ONE WHO ANSWERS WISHES)\nHIS COIN IS USED WORLD WIDE\nWE WILL ENDURE ALL TRIALS AND HE IS THE ONE WHO PROVIDE RESULTS

arabic text:
TERA DADA IMAM SADIQ HAI
JISKE DAM SE HAI JAFFERI SAARE
DEEN O MAZHAB SABAK IBADAT HAI
HAM KO SAYE USI KE DARSE MILE
english translation text:
YOUR GRANDFATHER IS IMAM SADIQ (A.S.)
THROUGH WHOSE EFFORTS WE ARE ALL JA’FFERI TODAY
SPREADING KNOWLEDGE IS A FORM OF WORSHIP
MAY WE GET PROTECTION UNDER HIS DOOR

arabic text:
HAI QARAMATE MURTAZA TUJHME
SAAILO KO BHI YET ATA TUJHME
RAD JO HOTI NAHI KISI SURAT
SAANS KETI HAI WOH DUA TUJHME
english translation text:
THE MIRACLES OF IMAM ALI (A.S.) ARE PRESENT IN YOU
AND YOU PROVIDE TO THE POOR & NEEDY
NO REQUESTS ARE EVER TURNED AWAY
THIS IS AN INTRINSIC PART OF YOUR NATURE

arabic text:
TERI BEHNA HAI QUM KI SHEHZADI
USKI CHAWKHAT PE DE SADA JO BHI
JOLIYA APNO BHAR KE LAATA HAI
GHAMSE MILTI HAI USKO AAZADI
english translation text: YOUR SISTER IS THE PRINCESS OF QUM\nWHOEVER MAKES A REQUESTS AT HER SHRINE, RETURNS WITH FULL OF BLESSINGS AND IS FREED FROM ALL GRIEF

arabic text:
HAI NAJAF DUSHMANO KE NARGE MAI
KARBALA SAMARA KE RASTE MAI
BEKAFAN MOMINO KE LAASHE HAI
KUFR DAAKHIL HWA MADINA MAI
english translation text: NAJAF IS SURROUNDED BY ENEMIES\nON THE ROAD TO KARBALA AND SAMARRA, THE BODIES OF THE BELIEVERS ARE WITHOUT SHROUDS AND THE NON BELIEVERS HAVE ENTERED MEDINA
